testo: Me again, it's Leo. You've been using EatMeFirst for four months now, and your pantry is full of valuable data. Are you relying only on your device's memory? Computers and smartphones can fail: the support plan with USB drive backup (on PC) or via convenient email sending (on mobile) is the real safety net for this app! By keeping it active, you can export and keep an updated backup copy outside of your main device: if your device crashes, you can reload everything onto a new one and find your entire inventory intact.
